Existing Gesher implementation corrected against the pinned source contracts
Restored AOSP source with annotation/build-check adaptations

adaptations: VpnTransportInfo omits source-only RedactionType and androidx RequiresApi annotations. For the API36 runtime, the module SdkLevel.isAtLeastU guard is expressed as Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34.

Local NetworkCapabilities retains its existing local parcel prefix and appends the previously omitted specifier, transport value and subscription IDs. Both writer and reader are updated together; this is not a claim to match the whole AOSP parcel wire layout.
Subscription IDs are defensive HashSet copies with the same public set behavior, matching by nonempty intersection.
Specifier matching calls canBeSatisfiedBy and recognizes MatchAll on the offered network, matching upstream.
